test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What will be the curved surface area of cylinder having radius 20 cm and height 34 cm? (use π = 3.14)
solution:
**Given**

Radius of the cylinder: 20 cm

Height of the cylinder: 34 cm

Value of π: 3.14

**Formula Used:**

The curved surface area of a cylinder is calculated using the formula: CSA = 2 × π × radius × height

**Solution:**

⇒ 2 × 3.14 × 20 × 34

⇒ 125.6 × 34 = 4270.4 cm2

**Therefore, the curved surface area of the cylinder is 4270.4 cm2**
